adjudication.rationale: In `embeddable-host.js.es6` the `save()` action sends `props.category_id = this.get('categoryId')`, where `categoryId` starts as `null` and is only set in `edit()` (existing rows) or via the chooser. If the chooser is left empty for a new host, Rails defaults `category_id` to `SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id` (`save_host`), but the client then runs `host.set('category', Discourse.Category.findById(this.get('categoryId')))` which becomes `findById(null)` => `undefined`, overriding any hydrated/returned category relation. Since the template renders `{{category-badge host.category}}`, this can display a blank category until reload, misrepresenting what the server saved.
